snippet.title: Battleborn: Montana and the Demon Bear
snippet.description: Grab some marshmallows and cozy up to the campfire, this outer space lumberjack has quite the story to tell. Montana must face down unimaginable horrors, survive the ambush, and hunt down the Demon Bear, all to save NOVA. Join the Battleborn as Montana recalls his encounter with a terrifying Varelsi beast in "Montana and the Demon Bear."
